Name: Greenly
Description:
Greenly is on a mission to democratize access to science-backed climate intelligence, transforming sustainability from a compliance burden into a strategic competitive advantage. 

In a world where sustainability once meant costly consultants, manual data entry, and static PDF reports, Greenly makes climate action accessible, precise, and actionable for everyone: from SMEs to global enterprises. 

Our all-in-one sustainability suite centralizes everything from carbon management and LCAs to ESG & CSRD reporting, backed by 4000+ delivered GHG reports, 10+ ESG frameworks, and a supplier platform engaging over 5,000 partners. Trusted by 3,500 clients in 25 countries, Greenly combines science-backed precision, with access to 300k+ emission factors and methodologies aligned with the GHG Protocol, ISO, and SBTi, with expert guidance from 70+ climate professionals, ensuring every company builds credible strategies and becomes smarter about climate as they go. 

Designed with efficient tech and intuitive UX, Greenly streamlines sustainability operations with integrations across 100+ softwares, automated quality controls, and real-time data visualizations, earning us top ratings (4.9 G2, 4.8 Capterra, 4.6 Trustpilot). 

Greenly empowers companies to own their climate expertise in-house and collectively drive impact toward our bold goal: avoiding 1 billion tons of CO2 by 2030.

Name: Ecolibrium
Description:
Ecolibrium is a sustainability tech company that empowers people to make better decisions based on proven data-driven ML algorithms through continuous monitoring, analysis and seamlessly integrated automated recommendation engines.

We accelerate organisations’ decarbonisation journey through real-time actionable insights on a single pane view, driving measurable actions to meet their Net-Zero goals while elevating productivity and reducing operational costs across their entire portfolio. It’s a finely tuned balance between people, planet and profit.

At Ecolibrium, we are dedicated to our partners-first approach. We walk hand-in-hand with our clients, ensuring a collaborative effort that drives sustainable, continuous improvement. We are more than just a technology provider; we are your dedicated partner in achieving common goals for a greener, more efficient organisation.

Ecolibrium is ISO 27001 certified and adheres to the ISMS framework of standards. We have won several awards over the last decade, including the prestigious WWF Climate Solver Award, the UNFCC award and the Ashden International Award.

Name: Sylvera
Description:
Sylvera is the independent carbon data platform trusted by buy and sell side market participants and policymakers to navigate the carbon market with confidence. 

We build data models and software tools that combine extensive project assessments, real-world market and pricing intelligence, and geospatial lidar monitoring to deliver actionable insights that drive real climate action.

Sylvera enables smarter, faster, and more confident decisions by combining quality indicator, price, and real-world performance data into a single source of truth.

We're backed by renowned investors like Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Insight Partners, LocalGlobe, and Salesforce Ventures.

Name: REConnect Energy
Description: REConnect Energy is a growth stage digital energy platform startup. We build AI and Grid Automation software products for renewables and energy utilities. Head quartered at Namma Bengaluru with young and energised pack of 165(Aug'23) spread across Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Mumbai and London.

Name: Climate X
Description:
Backed by Google Ventures, Climate X is the leading risk intelligence platform empowering financial institutions and real estate owners to turn climate risk into resilient returns.

From London to New York, our team of climate scientists and financial risk experts delivers decision-ready intelligence with absolute clarity — quantifying exposure, translating it into financial impact, and mapping the ROI path to resilience.

With Climate X, you can:

• Pinpoint at-risk assets globally in seconds anywhere in the world
• Assess vulnerability to 11+ climate hazards at both asset and portfolio level
• Quantify financial impact with precision — from Estimated Annual Loss to business disruption
• Prioritize and budget for adaptation with clear ROI and CapEx clarity

Trusted by institutions managing over $13 trillion in assets — including top-3 North American banks, global top-3 private equity firms, and leading global consultancies including Deloitte, Capgemini and Bain & Co — Climate X is setting the global benchmark for how organizations de-risk the future and unlock climate-aligned growth.

Learn more on our website or by contacting us via enquiries@climate-x.com.

Name: KarbonWise
Description:
KarbonWise is a sustainability solutions company that helps businesses take climate action with confidence and clarity.

We bring together expert advisory services and a cloud-based software platform to make sustainability measurable, manageable and meaningful.

From automated carbon accounting and life cycle analysis to ESG data management and reporting, we simplify the complex, so you can focus on what matters.

Our platform is built to align with leading global frameworks such as CSRD, GRI, TCFD and BRSR, making it easier to meet compliance requirements while delivering long-term value. At the same time, our advisory team supports clients with net zero strategy, supply chain engagement, climate risk assessments, and organisational enablement.

Whether you're just starting out or aiming for industry leadership, we meet you where you are - with the tools, insight and support to move forward, faster.

At KarbonWise, we believe sustainability should drive real business value, not just tick compliance boxes.

For every step of your journey.

Name: Jupiter Intelligence
Description: Jupiter is the trusted leader in climate risk analytics for organizations looking to strengthen their climate resilience. With forward-focused, rigorous methodologies and analytics delivered by some of the best scientists in the industry, Jupiter turns sophisticated climate science into actionable data. By managing, mitigating, and disclosing your climate risk, you can confront the challenges of tomorrow, today.

Name: Climate Compatible Growth
Description:
https://linktr.ee/climatecompatiblegrowth 
We support the #GlobalSouth to secure #ClimateInvestment in sustainable growth, infrastructure and projects. 
Climate Compatible Growth (CCG) is a £95m UK aid-funded research programme which is helping countries in the Global South to take a path of low-carbon development while simultaneously unlocking profitable investment in green infrastructure. We are also helping to open up new markets and supporting delivery of the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) from 2012.

Climate change is already causing major economic, social, and environmental damage, affecting global security, food systems, water resources, health, and ecosystems. Developing countries are at the most immediate risk. CCG can provide the right evidence at the right time on how developing countries can respond best to the need to move to low-carbon energy, against a backdrop of rapid tech transformations and geo-political upheaval.

In collaboration with national and international research partners, CCG is delivering the energy and transport system tools and decision support frameworks needed to create climate compatible growth and sustainable economic infrastructure. CCG aims to change the ‘rules of the game’, breaking away from siloed thinking to open new markets and jobs, shift financial flows, and make green transitions possible.
 
Our founding partners are: Imperial College London, the University of Oxford, the University of Cambridge, University College London, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, the Open University, the Climate Parliament, the Centre for Global Equality and Loughborough University where the administrative team are based. Strathclyde University joined as a partner in 2024.

Name: Mitiga Solutions
Description:
Mitiga helps organisations measure, report and act on physical climate risk — at asset level, globally, and in seconds.

Our platform, EarthScanTM, turns the world’s best climate science and AI into decision-ready intelligence.

 Customers use it to:
· Assess exposure to floods, heat stress, wildfires, wind and more
· Analyse single sites or entire portfolios
· Meet disclosure requirements under CSRD (ESRS E1), IFRS S2 / TCFD, and other global standards

 Scientific approach
· Multi-hazard modelling built on dynamically downscaled climate simulations and observed datasets
· Proprietary algorithms combining climate science, AI and high-performance computing for asset-level precision
· Quantifies uncertainty and provides transparent methodology to support regulatory and investor scrutiny

 Why choose Mitiga
· Regulatory-ready: Audit-ready outputs aligned with leading climate disclosure frameworks
· Asset-level precision: Hazard and impact modelling down to individual assets
· Built for scale: From one location to thousands, with bulk processing and API integration

 Who we work with
Mitiga is trusted by global insurers, asset managers, corporates and consultancies to deliver transparent, defensible physical climate risk insights that stand up to regulatory and investor scrutiny.

 Backed by
Kibo Ventures, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, Nationwide Ventures, Telefónica, CREAS Impacto and Faber.

 Ready to get started?
→ Visit mitigasolutions.com to explore EarthScan
→ Request a demo or trial with your own asset data
→ Scale your physical climate risk assessments with confidence

Name: Fathom
Description:
Fathom gives risk management professionals the most scientifically robust tools and intelligence for understanding the climate’s effects on flood risk. 

By publishing cutting-edge peer-reviewed academic research, and applying it to real-world challenges, Fathom enables stronger decision-making for a range of industries around the world, including (re)insurance, civil engineering, corporate risk, financial services, disaster response and government. 
 
As a dedicated team of scientists, Fathom harnesses its passion for innovation and the environment to develop rigorous catastrophe models and comprehensive mapping and geospatial data that make a real-world difference to customers and communities worldwide. 

As of December 2023, Fathom is part of Swiss Re. 

Interested in a career at Fathom? Visit our careers page: https://careers.fathom.global/

Name: Klimato
Description: Klimato delivers world-leading food climate data, deep industry expertise, and flexible solutions that help food businesses measure their impact, streamline reporting, and act on clear insights that drive climate reduction. Built specifically for the food industry, our tools and guidance improve reporting accuracy, strengthen carbon reduction strategies, and support credible, data-driven progress.

Name: Springwise
Description: At Springwise, we are dedicated to uncovering the most promising and impactful innovations from around the globe. Our mission is to inspire meaningful change by providing access to the latest ideas and trends that shape industries, sustainability efforts, and business practices worldwide.

Name: 2050 Materials
Description:
2050 Materials is driving the future of sustainable construction with a focus on data-driven decisions. 

Our platform and API empowers professionals in the built environment to accurately evaluate environmental impacts at every stage—from design to procurement. 

By harnessing our comprehensive database and innovative data collection methods, users gain the insights needed to achieve their climate objectives efficiently.

Name: Pledge
Description:
Pledge enables enterprises to calculate, report and track emissions across their entire logistics supply chain. We offer a cloud-based platform that automates the collection of shipment data from suppliers as well as the calculation and reporting of logistics emissions across all transport modes (air, inland and sea).

By collecting activity data directly from logistics suppliers, Pledge delivers transparent and traceable emissions data, empowering supply chain teams to meet their sustainability compliance obligations and helping drive emissions reduction at scale.

Pledge is accredited by the Smart Freight Centre (SFC) to be in conformance with the Global Logistics Emissions Council (GLEC) framework and aligned to ISO 14083.

Pledge's business has been acquired by Blue Yonder in 2025.

Name: Eliq
Description:
We help utilities turn energy data into something people actually understand and use.

Eliq started in Sweden in 2016 with a simple goal: to help people make sense of their energy usage. What began as a small team working with a single utility is now a platform used across 15+ markets – supporting millions of households and some of Europe’s most ambitious energy providers.

We’re not here to sell dashboards. We’re here to help utilities stay relevant – by making energy feel less like a black box, and more like something customers can control, learn from, and act on.

That means fewer calls. Lower churn. Smarter operations. Stronger relationships.
But more than anything, it means closing the gap between data and real-life impact.

Name: ASUENE Inc.
Description:
ASUENE is a leading AI Sustainability Integrated Platform, trusted by 64,000+ companies worldwide and backed by over US$160M in funding from investors including Decarbonization Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and SMBC.

Our flagship platform, ASUENE, supports GHG measurement, reduction, and reporting across Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions. ASUENE LCA enables product-level lifecycle assessment and carbon footprint (PCF) calculation, while ASUENE SUPPLY CHAIN helps enterprises engage suppliers and manage emissions data across complex, multi-tier supply chains.

Beyond our core platform, we offer a growing suite of specialized AI solutions: NZero, an AI Energy Optimization Platform; Carbon EX, an Integrated Carbon Credit AI Platform; Secaro, a Supply Chain Intelligence Network; and Iconic Air, an AI-powered Methane Emissions Management platform.

Through our AI-powered platforms and expert consulting — including third-party assurance and disclosure advisory via ASUENE VERITAS — we help companies of every size advance sustainability management, meet evolving regulatory requirements such as CSRD and CDP, and accelerate their transition toward net zero.

Name: Zevero
Description:
Zevero is a leading carbon management platform that empowers organisations to measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions with precision and efficiency. 

By combining AI-driven technology and guidance from in-house sustainability experts, Zevero streamlines climate action—helping businesses meet evolving market demands, align with global frameworks, and drive progress toward net zero.

To learn more, visit: https://www.zevero.earth/

Name: Faradai
Description:
Faradai provides multi-agent AI & analytics platform to accelerate decarbonization. We help enterprises to gather & obtain AI-powered clarity from real time energy, carbon & ESG data across their portfolio & supply chain. 

We are digitising the overall energy & sustainability value chain for enterprise companies and help them comply with sustainability regulations. With more than 200 existing international enterprise clients such as IKEA, Coca Cola, Allianz, Burger King, Tetrapak, CBRE, Marks & Spencer, Turkish Airlines, Heineken, Shell, Zara, BNP Paribas, Gap, Banana Republic, ISS, Vodafone, PepsiCo in 42 countries, we have a strong technology offering and a top-notch product culture. Name: Lune
Description:
Supply chain emissions data is broken.

Shippers are chasing carriers for spreadsheets. Logistics companies are losing tenders because they can't answer basic CO2 questions. Scope 3 reporting is becoming a legal requirement, not to mention the emission reductions challenge.

Lune fixes this from both ends of the supply chain.

For logistics providers: an API and platform to automatically give their customers CO2 visibility, reporting, and greener shipment recommendations. A way to stand out, win tenders, and turn sustainability into a commercial advantage.

For enterprise shippers: a platform that automatically collects shipment data from all logistics providers, delivers granular CO2 calculations across every freight mode, and produces audit-ready reporting — without the spreadsheets.

One platform. Both sides of the problem. No manual effort.

Trusted by industry leaders including Visa, AstraZeneca, Puma, JAS Worldwide, Logwin and more.

→ lune.co

Name: Carbon Accounting Alliance (CAA)
Description:
The Carbon Accounting Alliance (CAA) is a collective of 2,300+ professionals and organisations based in 65+ countries who measure and report carbon emissions. Collectively our Members measure carbon footprints for more than 200,000+ companies. Our alliance is a mixture of independent professionals, software companies, consultancies, auditors and certifying bodies who have come together to collaborate on solving challenges faced by our industry, to share best practices and promote the robust development and implementation of standards. 

Our priorities include: 

•	Technical Alignment: to develop practical guidance and consistent interpretation of carbon accounting standards.

•	Professionalisation of our Sector: to develop and drive adoption of the first professional qualification for carbon accounting in collaboration with industry bodies. 

•	Engagement with Policy & Standards: to ensure that development and implementation of policies and standards are ambitious, fit for purpose and consider the industry’s point of view.

Name: Climate Crisis Advisory Group

Name: Verdentum
Description: Verdentum's technology helps leading philanthropic organizations, financial institutions and NGOs launch, coordinate, and track impact on projects around the world. With high levels of customizability, real-time data analysis, and new-age features driven by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Verdentum's technology presents cutting-edge possibilities for greater efficiency.

Name: Gardin
Description:
At Gardin, our vision is simple, to create a real-world operating system that will power the future of farming by helping food producers deliver superior yields, nutrition and quality. A complete closed-loop growth & nutritional optimisation platform for all crop production. 

Plant Driven Growing with Gardin Pulse - Our state-of-the-art optical remote sensing technology, machine vision and analytics, allow producers to measure plant physiology and proactively adjust parameters for optimised operations.

Gardin enables end-to-end control of the process. Resulting in less waste with increased efficiency, improved margins from higher quality, and healthier consumers from the ability to measure and quantify the nutritional content of our food.

Gardin has developed a novel plant photosynthesis sensor. This groundbreaking proprietary technology is designed to allow farmers to directly interact with their plants and provides insights that help farmers optimise the use of resources that plants need to grow. Gardin’s unique data helps to improve energy efficiency, reduce crop loss from pests or diseases and empower farms to adapt their practice to a changing climate. In addition, Gardin’s technology is being used in research to develop novel seed varieties that are more robust to a warming climate. Overall, Gardin provides a solution for ensuring a resilient supply of affordable, nutritious and sustainable food.

Name: Ocean Ledger
Description: Ocean Ledger is a geospatial specialist for coastal flood risk, one of the most severe and mispriced secondary perils in the P&C market. Ocean Ledger's blended view of risk includes a proprietary surge model, which fuses satellite, LiDAR, and sensor data into dynamically updated coastal topography maps and historical trends at 10m resolution.

Name: International Climate Councils Network
Description: The International Climate Councils Network supports and amplifies the work of a growing network of climate councils: 29 expert bodies officially mandated to advise their governments on climate policy. Countries urgently need to take action, grounded in evidence, to secure a path to a sustainable future. Strengthening climate governance with effective climate councils will be critical to making that possible.

Name: Open Hydro
Description:
Open Hydro is a mission-led organisation whose vision is a climate resilient, zero-carbon planet where water and energy are accessible to all. 

We live in a time of climate emergency where hydropower assets have an unprecedented role in addressing the global challenges we face, including water and energy access. Without reliable climate-related information and metrics that consider both water and energy services provided, hydropower projects risk continuing to struggle to demonstrate their role and contribution to tackle climate change and attract the necessary climate finance support.

Open Hydro works to mobilise investment in hydropower; help the sector demonstrate climate action in mitigation, resilience and adaptation; and advance in the corporate and project level disclosure of climate-related risks and opportunities.

Name: 51toCarbonZero
Description:
51toCarbonZero is the First Climate & Sustainability-Success Platform - combining proprietary software with hands-on expert advisory to help organisations measure, improve and report their carbon and ESG performance. 

We deliver sustainability success through three integrated capabilities:

-Measure & Report — Precise carbon footprint and ESG measurement across all scopes, with 40,000+ emission factors and a 1.5 million-supplier chain intelligence database.
-Transition — Accountable net-zero planning, SBTi target-setting, and governance structures that drive real-world reduction.
-Engage — Stakeholder communication tools that bring boards, colleagues, suppliers, clients, and investors on the journey.

Every client relationship is powered by Climate UnlimitedTM — our advisory model that replaces hourly consulting with continuous, named expert support. No scoped projects. No re-procurement. From day one, each client has a dedicated, ISO-certified Climate Success Manager embedded as an extension of their team.

Why it works

Our approach boosts corporate transition success rates by 73%, delivers up to 42% resource savings versus traditional methods, and enables carbon measurement up to 40% faster. We hold a 100% audit pass rate and 100% SBTi success rate across all clients, with a 9/10 client satisfaction score.

With a wide range of meteorological and oceanographic variables, the platform delivers critical insights to support decision-making in complex operations across multiple markets.

Name: Scrapp | Certified B-Corp
Description:
What is Scrapp?
Founded in 2019, Scrapp is on a mission to transform the way people and businesses achieve their zero-waste goals, through digitizing their waste streams with technology. By providing the digital tools to monitor and measure their waste, we are empowering organizations around the world to turn the tap off at the source of the waste problem.

What do we do?
Scrapp develops waste data tracking and communication software for organizations to automate the monitoring of their material resource consumption, and then communicate the positive impact being made through its suite of digital tools.

What is the mission?
At Scrapp, our mission is simple: educate and empower a global community towards a circular future.

Name: Weather Trade Net
Description:
Weather Trade Net helps companies and communities identify, measure, anticipate, and mitigate weather-induced loss and damage. Founded in 2022 by Elena Maksimovich, PhD in Climatology and Geophysics, alumna of Pierre et Marie Curie University, Paris-6, the company is driven by a mission to democratize climate risk knowledge and integrate it into sustainability reporting, credit risk modeling, and insurance practices.

At Weather Trade Net, we know that climate risk assessment is more than just data, it’s knowledge for informed decision-making. 

That’s why we are committed to delivering high-quality, user-friendly analytical solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights.

 Decision-level climate data
 Asset-level
 Granular risk scores & probability assessments
 In-depth reports tailored to economic sectors & business needs

As climate regulations and corporate compliance requirements evolve, our technology meets the growing complexity of reporting standards, especially as insurers withdraw from high-risk areas.

 Company ratings

Name: DitchCarbon

Our platform beats generic ESG reporting tools by automating the collection of primary emissions data—eliminating the need for tedious supplier surveys and freeing up valuable sustainability time for real decarbonisation.

We provide detailed emissions reduction pathways, equipping enterprises with supplier-level data to identify, prioritise, and manage initiatives that drive measurable impact. 

Our advanced forecasting capabilities deliver more accurate and actionable emissions projections than competitors, enabling smarter planning and decision-making.

Name: Climate Court
Description:
Climate Court is your leading platform for tracking and analysing climate change litigation worldwide. #ClimateLitigation #ClimateLaw #ClimateJustice

Trusted by UK FTSE100 companies, SmartResilience quantifies the cost of climate disruptions and produces the audit-ready disclosures that regulators and investors now require, including IFRS S2, TCFD, CSRD, ASRS and UK SRS.

Name: experienz
Description: experienz focuses on enabling organisations to drive greater impact on the people and planet through ESG simplification. experienz adapts global ESG standards and simplifies data aggregation and reporting.

Name: Olsights
Description:
Olsights is a clean energy software company specialising in advanced data visualisation and analytics to support the transition to a low-carbon future. We enable project developers, policymakers, and supply chains to plan, assess, and accelerate decarbonisation initiatives—particularly in the areas of Hydrogen and Carbon Capture, Utilisation, and Storage (CCUS).

Our flagship platform, Olsights Eye, integrates interactive digital mapping with powerful analytics to provide clear, actionable insights. It helps users evaluate site feasibility, assess storage potential, optimise infrastructure, and analyse environmental, economic, and regulatory impacts.

With Olsights Eye, users can:
• Visualise energy infrastructure, transport networks, and demand hubs
• Explore CO2 storage sites and hydrogen supply routes
• Model scenarios
• Understand regional opportunities and policy context

As governments and industries scale up Hydrogen and CCUS to meet net-zero targets, our tools reduce uncertainty and support faster, more strategic decision-making. By transforming complex datasets into intuitive visual formats, we make energy transition planning more accessible and transparent.

Already supporting major UK brands, we are expanding globally to drive smarter clean energy investments and accelerate the deployment of low-carbon technologies.

Olsights is built on expertise in engineering, energy systems, and digital innovation. We work closely with early adopters and public stakeholders to develop tools that reflect real-world needs and deliver impact at scale.

By making clean energy data easier to understand and use, we’re helping unlock the full potential of decarbonisation projects—from concept to execution.

 www.olsights.com
 hello@olsights.com

Seedling helps 500+ businesses to measure, reduce, and report their carbon footprint with confidence.

 Full-scope, GHG Protocol compliant carbon footprints

Name: TMP
Description:
Our near-term climate models, combined with expertise in social, environmental and security risk analysis, help a diverse range of stakeholders to prepare for extreme weather events and their knock on impacts in the 2020s. We do this via charitable and commercial projects with partners including governments, investors, corporates, research institutions, NGOs and foundations. 

We create unique geospatial risk models that help partners understand, prepare for and respond to the challenges they will face from cumulative climate risks over the next few years. We also go further by connecting stakeholders so they can collaborate on the design and implementation of locally and regionally-specific solutions to systems risks. Our approach is based on factors that include:

1. Climate change is accelerating, with severe climate catastrophes already occurring more and more frequently across the planet

2. There is a lack of information on how climate change will impact lives in the 2020s.

3. Effective solutions must be locally specific and bottom-up, or at the very least have buy in at the local level

Name: Highland Adapts
Description: Highland Adapts was established in 2021 to facilitate collaborative action for a climate-ready Highland region. The Highland Adapts partnership is equally governed by nine founding partner organisations: The Highland Council, Highlands and Islands Enterprise, Zero Waste Scotland, Verture, NatureScot, Forestry and Land Scotland, The Highlands and Islands Climate Hub, Changeworks, and NHS Highland.

Name: Bennett Institute for Innovation and Policy Acceleration
Description: The Bennett Institute is uniquely positioned to accelerate policy and practical solutions at unprecedented speed. Our work will set a new pace for policy change that is based on scientific evidence. We collaborate with governments and institutions around the world to develop impactful work that effectively addresses the climate challenge.

Name: POP - People Owned Power | B Corp Certified
Description:
Powered by One Zero Energy, POP are empowering communities to install, generate, store and share their own renewable energy, street by street, neighbourhood by neighbourhood. Bills go down, energy security goes up, and power flows to where it belongs: in the hands of people. 

We work with local tradespeople to develop their skills, making sure money made locally, stays invested in your community. Cutting bills without compromising energy security, for a fairer share of power for all.
Location: Lewes, East Sussex, England, United Kingdom

Name: Trex
Description: Decision-grade Dynamic Systems Intelligence for financial institutions. Trex Climate is our inaugural capability, delivering non-linear energy transition and extreme weather insights to strengthen resilience and reveal opportunities.

Name: World Weather Attribution
Description:
World Weather Attribution (WWA) is an international collaboration of scientists that answers whether climate change influenced an extreme weather event in its immediate aftermath. Using peer-reviewed methods and real-time data, we examine the links between human-induced climate change and the likelihood of heatwaves, coldwaves, floods, droughts, and storms.

Who are we?

WWA is a partnership between Imperial College London, KNMI (The Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute) and Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre. Each study also involves partner institutes in impacted regions around the world.  

Why do we do it?

We provide robust, rapid scientific analysis about whether - and how much - climate change has influenced or exacerbated an extreme weather event. The findings inform public conversations around the impacts of climate change and how to adapt to future extremes.

Our two-step approach:

Rapid Attribution: Delivering robust scientific results in just days or weeks on whether climate change played a role in an extreme weather event. 
Vulnerability and Exposure: To provide learnings on adaptation, we also analyse the unique human-driven vulnerabilities that turn events into disasters.

Our Impact:

Since 2014, WWA has conducted over 120 studies and had more than 40 peer reviewed papers published, providing an evidence base for scientists, policy-makers, journalists and communities to discuss climate mitigation and adaptation with clarity and confidence.

Media inquiries: wwamedia@imperial.ac.uk
Explore our latest studies: worldweatherattribution.org

Name: CETFI
Description: At CETFI (Climate and Energy Transition Finance Initiative), we are a multi-stakeholder alliance committed to accelerating climate finance in emerging markets. Our mission is to bridge the gap between ambitious climate goals and the financial resources needed to achieve them. By enabling partnerships between global investors, industry leaders, and governments, CETFI develops innovative financial structures that make sustainable projects more viable and impactful. We recognise the critical role that the Global South plays in the global climate fight, and we are dedicated to ensuring that these regions receive the support necessary to drive meaningful change.

Name: C-SINK Project
Description: The C-SINK project aims to establish robust MRV pre-standards and policy strategies to lay the foundations for a standardized, responsible and transparent European CDR market. C-SINK will provide a holistic and unbiased understanding of CDR technologies, through a comprehensive evaluation of not only the technological aspects of CDR, but also environmental, social and governance (ESG) criteria relevant to CDR.

Name: Poseira
Description:
Poseira (formerly Plastic-i) uses satellite imagery and AI models to transform complex water signals into auditable, continuous insights for decision makers navigating water-based ecosystems.

Our capabilities extend to a growing set of applications, including plastic debris tracking, harmful algal bloom prediction, blue carbon monitoring, aquaculture oversight, and insurance risk modelling for water-based hazards - each requiring continuous observation over infrequent, in-situ checks.

We serve clean-up operators and NGOs prioritising intervention efforts, water utilities monitoring catchments,  and government bodies overseeing water quality and licensing, blue carbon project developers verifying restoration outcomes, and aquaculture operators managing site risk. We also support insurers and brokers with objective triggers and indices for pricing underserved water perils.

We are a UK-based, 2x Earthshot Prize-nominated, Lloyd's Lab-incubated company. Follow Poseira for updates on our work, or visit poseira.com to get in touch.

Name: Orbital Micro Systems (Weather Stream)
Description:
Orbital Micro Systems is a wholly owned subsidiary of Weather Stream, Inc.  Make certain to follow Weather Stream's LinkedIN page!

With our proprietary instruments and satellite systems, Weather Stream will provide never before seen 15-minute updates of weather conditions around the globe, including currently under-observed regions such as South and Central Asia, Africa and the Polar Regions.

Name: Mission Spiritus
Description:
Mission Spiritus is a bold and ambitious initiative comprising seven major science-focused expeditions to gather micro and nanoplastic samples from some of the world’s most remote locations.

Led by Alan Chambers MBE, Mission Spiritus is dedicated to accelerating vital research on the future of the climate and human health by conducting science-driven expeditions across remote regions on each continent.

Each Mission Spiritus expedition will collect critical data on the distribution of micro and nano plastics. As plastic waste breaks down, it infiltrates almost every environment – including the air, ocean depths, drinking water, and even the human body – posing substantial risks to all life forms.

Mission Spiritus aims to deliver evidence-based insights that enable impactful solutions, driving meaningful transformational change on one of humanity’s most pressing environmental crises.

Name: Kohtari
Description:
We’re a Global Water Intelligence company, bringing digital visibility to our planet’s most precious resource.

By combining AI, IoT and Data, we reveal previously invisible water insights. From real-time monitoring to prediction and management. Our solutions turn complex data into actionable intelligence. We help water companies make faster, smarter decisions that protect both water and reputation.

Our vision is a world where every significant water body is digitally visible, understood and protected, ensuring resilient ecosystems, healthier communities and a thriving blue economy.

As part of a £7m Ofwat-funded project and building on Kohtari’s heritage in AI and Data, we’re advancing two breakthrough capabilities:

Name: Econori
Description: Econori is a data platform that brings all your ESG data together into a single source of truth. We ingest data from any source and in any format, fill your ESG knowledge gaps, and enable you to meet all the ever-evolving ESG reporting requirements. More than just a software platform our sustainability experts are on hand to support you with fractional ESG services, pointing out insights and suggesting practical solutions.

Name: Vyzrd
Description:
VyzrdTM is the industry leading climate risk and ESG integration intelligence platform. Our Gen-AI enabled platform quantifies the financial, strategic and operational implications of climate change and ESG to company performance and valuation. 

Vyzrd offers industry leading climate and ESG solutions to diverse clients, including Fortune 500 companies, consulting firms, governments, financial institutions, corporates, and SMEs. Our solutions empower executives, Boards, and investors with business-critical insights for a range of use-cases including investment analysis, portfolio assessment, M&A transactions, Net Zero strategies, among others.

Name: RedLines
Description:
RedLines provides decision-grade climate risk analysis for asset-heavy organisations.

We integrate physical climate risk with market-driven transition pressures at asset and supply-chain level, helping organisations understand exposure to disruption, cost volatility and long-term viability risk.

Our work supports risk, finance, insurance and operations teams when climate risk must withstand board scrutiny, audit challenge or capital allocation decisions.

RedLines operates upstream of ESG and GRC systems, providing the risk intelligence that governance and reporting frameworks rely on.

Our vision is to be global leaders in climate risk management, assisting companies around the world to:

Identify Risks
Seize Opportunities
Build Resilience

We believe in preventing the adverse effects of climate change and guiding businesses towards sustainable practices that contribute to a resilient and profitable future. Whether your goals are to enhance sustainability, maximise profitability, manage risks, or strengthen your supply chain, our solutions are designed to meet your specific needs. We help you identify risks, seize opportunities, and build resilience in a rapidly changing world.

Discover how we can transform your approach to climate risk and sustainability.

Name: Metswift
Description: MetSwift provides unrivalled and actionable weather predictions and intelligence to enable better decisions.

Name: notch
Description:
At notch, we believe carbon accounting is not simply compliance - it’s a business opportunity. Our activity-based, user-centric software has already empowered over 1000 organisations to track, measure and report their emissions, and to move confidently toward Net Zero.
Our platform delivers statutory-grade reporting, fully aligned with international GHG-Protocol standards, with robust audit trails built in. We turn what many regard as a cost or burden into a strategic lever: bringing clarity, efficiency and growth to your operations.
Alongside our software, we provide a supported service - whether directly from our team or via our network of expert partners - to develop and implement carbon-reduction plans, set targets and integrate sustainability into your business model.
Whether you’re just starting your emissions journey, or scaling sophisticated reporting across your value chain, notch is built to support you. Let us help you turn carbon accounting into a catalyst for business improvement.

Name: Tova
Description:
Tova is pioneering deep-learning technologies for climate-smart water management. We aim to create the best possible water resources insights for proactive management of the risks and opportunities of a changing earth.

Water is complicated. There is no easy and reliable way to understand and manage water risk. Tova's WaterProofTM platform makes it simple. SilvaCert is a specialist technical advisory firm supporting AFOLU carbon projects and forest-based certification systems.

Description:

Description: CLIMATE-ADAPT4EOSC project helps researchers in various disciplines to better address climate change in their research by providing an EOSC-centred collaborative research environment that is equipped with existing EOSC data and services and extended with new data and innovative services, such as FAIRification and Mapping and Entity Matching features. Name: Climate Cartographics
Description:
Climate Cartographics is a not-for-profit design research studio (Community Interest Company) working at the intersection of climate, cartography and data visualisation. We help organisations understand and communicate environmental change through maps, geospatial analysis and visual storytelling.

Name: SUS-POL Research Programme
Description:
Achieving the goals of the Paris Agreement requires a new approach to climate governance that gets to the heart of the climate crisis: fossil fuel production. Efforts to mitigate climate change over the last three decades have predominantly targeted end-use emissions. But given the urgency of cutting emissions and the necessity of leaving large amounts of fossil fuels in the ground, this approach is no longer sufficient. 

The SUS-POL research programme is exploring a radical new approach to climate governance: one that centres policies which seek to reduce the supply of fossil fuels to the energy system. Funded by UKRI Frontiers programme and based, SUS-POL is based at the School of Global Studies at the University of Sussex. 

Drawing on the fields of global political economy, international relations, sociology, geography and transitions studies, the SUS-POL project seeks to identify the political, economic, cultural and social conditions and processes that give rise to, and help to spread, policies that seek to limit fossil fuel production and ensure that reserves remain in the ground.

Name: Terra Motion Limited
Description:
Terra Motion is a leading provider of high-precision land deformation monitoring capabilities. With our patent-pending processing algorithm, APSISTM, we offer unique land survey solutions with unparalleled coverage abilities over a near-global reach.

Specialising in Water Leak Detection, Critical Infrastructure Monitoring, Peatland Condition Monitoring and Risk Slide Assessment.

Name: Tempest Risk
Description:
Tempest is a team of physical climate risk and resilience management scientists with expertise in global property and natural capital risk. As well as modelling risk, our platform an APIs help client quantify the ROI of alternative climate adaptation measures. Supporting both property risk in the financial services and corporate sector as well as natural capital, we're passionate about translating climate risk into informed decision-making for our clients.

Location: North Yorkshire, England, England, United Kingdom

Name: Ocean Intelligence
Description:
At Ocean Intelligence, we leverage real-time data to empower marine farmers, enhance productivity, and preserve the health of marine ecosystems.
Our platform combines real-time environmental data with advanced analytics to help you make informed decisions, optimise your operations, and ensure sustainability. Currently, we offer alpha versions of species-specific dashboards for mussels and salmon, with oysters and algae in the works.

Name: SABZA
Description: Accelerate climate. change initiatives through Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain and Machine Learning.

Name: CarbonCut
Description:
Most companies talk about sustainability at the end of the year.
We built CarbonCut for teams who can’t afford to wait that long.

The idea was simple: emissions shouldn’t be a mystery revealed in a report a year after the damage is done. Businesses deserve to know their impact the moment it’s created, and have the ability to act on it instantly.

CarbonCut began with that frustration: the gap between what companies want to do for the climate and the tools they actually have. Spreadsheets, estimates, delayed audits, none of these belong in a world that runs on real-time systems.

So we created one.

CarbonCut gives organisations the ability to measure, reduce, and offset carbon emissions in real time.
Not quarterly. Not annually. Live.

Our platform connects data that already exists inside a company and turns it into immediate clarity: where emissions are coming from, what’s causing them, and how to reduce them before they grow into problems. And whatever can’t be reduced can be offset instantly, with full transparency.

It’s sustainability done at the speed of business, precise, verifiable, and built for people who want to act, not just report.

Name: Biomet.life
Description: Biomet.life is a cloud-based AI platform that helps organisations build resilience to nature-related risks. Our models quantify and monitor biodiversity change and its impact, translating complex ecological data into clear, actionable intelligence. We enable decision-makers to design effective, auditable interventions that strengthen biodiversity capital and support long-term environmental and operational resilience, delivering strategic business insights and compliant regulatory reporting.

Name: NeoNetra
Description:
Our vision is a world where every sourcing decision is climate-smart by default and we are on a mission to embed carbon into the DNA of procurement globally. At NeoNetra, we enable our customers and their suppliers to improve performance while lowering carbon emissions - all directly in the flow of their work. Think of us like Google Maps - we pull in all the traffic data, the road closures, the speed limits, and then give buyers and suppliers the fastest, smartest route to save costs, reduce risks and capitalize on opportunities while cutting carbon - right inside the tools they already use.
Join us to scale responsible supply chains.

Name: Breathe Points
Description:
Breathe Points is more than just a platform; it's a movement. It's about empowering over 1 billion individuals to become champions for the living planet, one action at a time. 

Imagine a world where your daily activities, like choosing to walk or bike instead of drive, or opting for renewable energy, could make a difference in slowing the rate of climate change.

Through cutting-edge technology and innovative data tracking, Breathe Points enables users to monitor their carbon footprint in real-time, gaining insights into the environmental impact of their actions. But it doesn't stop there. Breathe Points also rewards users for their positive contributions to the planet, turning climate-conscious behaviours into real-world collective actions.

The Breathe Points platform and marketplace drive loyalty and collaboration, with a focus on environmental and social impact while also providing investors with a clear path to financial returns. By bringing together Cities, Corporations, and Citizens and leveraging our technology for data analysis, we have the ability to monetise and effectively support responsible growth.

Join us in breathing new life into our planet, one point at a time.

Name: EcoLedger
Description:
EcoLedger is sustainability disclosure software for companies reporting under CSRD, ESRS, ISSB S1 and S2, EU Taxonomy, UK SRS and TCFD. Self-serve, audit-ready, and built for the finance and sustainability teams now expected to own the reporting cycle in-house.

Most companies know they need to report. Far fewer know where to begin, and fewer still want to spend tens of thousands on consultants every year just to work it out.

EcoLedger was built by people who sat on both sides of the table, drafting, reviewing, and analysing sustainability disclosures across some of the world's largest listed companies. We took what good consultants actually do and turned it into software.

Choose your framework. EcoLedger tells you exactly what data to gather, walks you through every disclosure step, and produces structured, audit-ready output, all inside the platform. The same rigour you would expect from a Big Four engagement, at a fraction of the cost, and on your timeline rather than theirs.

What we cover today:
CSRD and ESRS reporting (all topical and cross-cutting standards)
ISSB S1 and S2 climate disclosure
EU Taxonomy alignment and eligibility
UK Sustainability Reporting Standards and TCFD
Double materiality assessment
Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG accounting

We built EcoLedger on a simple premise. Sustainability compliance is structured, learnable, and should not require expensive external support every year. Better disclosure data should not be the privilege of organisations that can afford traditional consultancy. It should be accessible, repeatable, and built for the companies now being asked to report more rigorously than ever.

For organisations navigating today's frameworks and preparing for those still evolving.

www.theecoledger.com

At WATAI, we provide the knowledge and tools you need to build water abundance and grow your green capital. Our focus is on ensuring water self-sufficiency and economic stability through nature-based solutions that work in harmony with local ecosystems.

Join us in building tomorrow, today

Name: PHI Oxford
Description:
Welcome to the Planetary Health Informatics (PHI) Lab. Planetary Health research considers the interconnections between our health and changes to our environment. Our approach to research combines artificial intelligence technology , satellite-data, and international real-world data from a range of global health and environmental sources, aiming to improve our understanding of chronic and communicable disease, monitor the impact of changes to the climate and environment on human health, and address sources of health inequality across the globe.

We work closely with an interdisciplinary group of collaborators, including clinicians, engineers, epidemiologists, conservationists, data scientists and public and patient groups across the UK, Europe, Latin America, South Asia and Africa, co-creating equitable and ethical solutions to issues connected to healthcare and climate change.

Name: Dashe
Description:
Dashe is automated carbon accounting software for UK businesses. Audit-ready SECR, CSRD and GHG Protocol reporting across Scope 1, 2 and 3, built from live source data.

Most carbon reporting still runs on spreadsheets and chased data, or not at all. Dashe automates the lot.

Dashe captures activity data at source from the systems you already run: telematics, smart meters, travel and shipments. AI classifies the data and converts it to emissions, so you get one live carbon footprint rather than spend-based estimates.

One platform covers the whole business: travel and fleet, sites and energy, digital, products, supply chain and waste. Reporting aligns to the frameworks UK businesses are judged on, including the GHG Protocol, SECR, CSRD, TCFD and ISO 14064. For firms bidding for work, that includes Scope 3 reporting and the Scope 1, 2 and 3 numbers a Carbon Reduction Plan (PPN 006) asks for.

Dashe is built in Leeds by a team that spent seven years compiling carbon reports by hand. Every figure in a Dashe report traces back to the source record it came from, and your data stays yours: exportable at any time.

Currently working with businesses across logistics, construction, sport and services, from single-site firms to enterprise groups.

Pricing is simple: a baseline set by your headcount, plus the integrations you choose, so you pay for what you use. Integration bundles start at £40 a month, a fraction of typical consultant fees for the same reports.

If your team is losing days to carbon data, or your tenders now demand credible numbers, book a 20-minute demo.

Book a demo: dashe.ai/book-a-demo

Or use the Visit website button above.

Name: Irrefutable
Description: Irrefutable provides institutional-grade research and advisory services for commodities, carbon markets, and frontier environmental markets.

Name: GHGBlaze
Description:
**PLEASE NOTE: GHGBLAZE is now Dormant.**

In a world where companies are under increasing pressure from investors, regulators and customers to track and report Scope 3 supply chain emissions, GHGBlaze is the first, specialised climate data and analytics provider for the commodities sector, that can bring transparency to emissions associated with complex commodity value chains.
  
This is because only GHGBlaze leverages the power of blockchain to create an immutable and scalable trail of operator-provided emissions data for individual cargoes of commodity product, allowing commodity producers and traders to accurately measure and manage emissions associated with their portfolios.

Name: Escrow-Tech
Description:
Escrow-Tech is a digital infrastructure business enabling the creation of a derivative market to help expand the utility of underlying physical assets in energy, water, and transport spaces. We capture these assets by deploying our smart IoT devices (hardware) across residential and non-residential spaces and leveraging flexibility (via our software) in orchestrating the operations of these assets to enable the onboarding of high-energy demand users like data centres.

Our goal is to cut down the deployment time of data centres to under 6 months and enable the trading of capacity in energy, water, and transport networks in real-time.

We hold two US patents – US Patent 12,333,457 and US Patent 12,327,263, with two more on device-level orchestration and real-time demand counterbalancing pending. In the UK, we are authorised by the FCA and hold ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 certifications for Carbon-Adjust. Our hardware stack is UKCA, FCC, and CE certified.

We have global operations across the UK with expansions planned for Europe and the US in 2026.

Name: Fangorn
Description:
Fangorn Group Limited is a remote-first environmental data company focused on precision forestry, carbon accounting, and ground-truth data for machine learning applications. We design and run field data collection campaigns using UAV-mounted LiDAR, hyperspectral, optical and satellite based data delivering structured datasets and models to clients in forestry, agriculture, conservation, and land management.

Our work supports individual tree-level biomass and carbon estimation, species classification, and structural monitoring across forests, estates, and agricultural land. We can combine airborne data with ground truth from core sampling and harvest machinery to train scalable models for carbon stock assessment and Forest intelligence.

Fangorn also provides data infrastructure and processing workflows, using Python, QGIS, ENVI, Pix4D, and machine learning frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow and XGBoost. Outputs include 3D reconstructions, carbon reports, vegetation indices and asset maps.

We operate across the UK, Africa, and Europe. We’re part of the Carbon13 Venture Launchpad and the Innovate UK Business Growth programme, with a focus on supporting the climate transition through applied remote sensing and data science.

Fangorn prioritises low-carbon operations, and supports local offset schemes where possible.

Name: Carbon Pesa Limited
Description:
C:Pesa is a UK based Company that is implementing an end-to-end digital solution for the production of enhanced and verifiable digital Energy Attribute Certificates [EACs] called the “C:Pesa DIGIREC.  

C:Pesa’s mission is to revolutionize the market for Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs), promoting a faster and fairer transition to net-zero, carbon free electricity. EACs are generated to reflect carbon-free electricity produced through solar, wind, geothermal, and hydro sources, and are used by utilities, investment funds, and corporates to certify their use of renewable electricity to achieve global sustainability and ESG goals. Our innovative, patent-pending approach digitizes the end-to-end process, enabling us to provide EACs that are transparent, verifiable, and tradable. This allows us to tap into global low carbon power generation sources that have historically been too small or not been considered trustworthy to access environmental value markets. With rapidly growing clean electricity needs, especially with the expansion of data centres to support generative AI, the demand for EACs is likely to boom over the next decade, and C:Pesa is uniquely placed to confirm net zero, carbon free electricity using the C:Pesa DIGIREC technology solution.

The C:Pesa DIGIREC technology solution provides digital evidence for independent third party verification of low carbon power generation using the I-TRACK Standard Foundation’s taxonomy (https://www.trackingstandard.org/product-code/electricity/). Using this taxonomy to issue a digital C:Pesa DIGIREC, the platform automatically embeds an International Renewable Energy Certificate for Electricity relating to the clean energy generated along with additional data collected at the source of clean energy generation wrapped into a digital certificate.

Name: Kaasai
Description: AI native data and analytics platform designed to solve the problems in energy transition.

Name: ekoIntelligence
Description: ekoIntelligence helps companies, investors and consultants identify and manage supply chain risks, including environmental, social and ethical harms, by turning complex data into actionable insights for smarter, safer business decisions.

Name: Calterra
Description: Our mission is to accelerate global nature restoration efforts by providing cutting-edge AI technology that connects landowners, developers, and restoration specialists, making sustainable land management not just an aspiration but an achievable reality.

Name: Resordinate
Description:
Industry and commerce generate 90% of the world's waste, yet more than 60% of this material is still landfilled or leaks into the environment.   This represents a significant value retention opportunity, which is hampered by poor, incompatible and missing data on materials and waste in the industrial and commercial system.  Resordinate addresses this challenge by enabling a fundamental shift towards recovery and reuse at scale, creating the reference data infrastructure for waste flowing through this system.   Our commercial proposition is generating digital twins of the operational waste systems across large, complex enterprises (WasteMap).  Each WasteMap deployment creates visibility and trust in operational waste data for sustainability, environment and finance teams.  This enables them to optimise materials budgets, reduce cost and risk, identify efficiencies, measure impact and validate targets and reporting.

2) To push for greater transparency about the colleges’ climate efforts. 

3) To form a knowledge base of easily accessible information which students and staff may use to understand and influence their colleges’ climate commitments.


How do we rank colleges?

Since their inception, the CLOC tables have been based on 4 key areas: decarbonisation, divestment, delinking, and governance. This has remained true despite changes in the methodological details as we believe these best capture colleges' responsibility as financially and socially influential institutions.
 
Our current marking process starts with a questionnaire that is sent to colleges directly. We use their responses, as well as any publicly available relevant information we can find, to mark the different questions included in our mark scheme. These are then weighted appropriately across the 4 areas to give a final score that we use for the rankings.

Name: Quantum Envelope
Description:
Quantum Envelope is the settlement layer for atmospheric methane. 

It reconciles the clashing readings from satellites, sensors and companies’ own reports into a single figure regulators can enforce and markets can price.

Methane is the fastest lever on near-term warming, and the EU Methane Regulation is forcing the market from estimated emissions to proven ones, with hard requirements from 2027. The layer that makes proof possible does not exist yet.

The hard part is producing a number that survives challenge. The sources disagree, and carrying the uncertainty across the jump in scale, from ground sensors to satellites, is the unsolved step everything rests on. We are not a sensing company. We take readings from satellites, sensors and operators, our own included where it helps, and resolve them into one emissions number, attributed to its source and traceable to a national standard.

A proven number is what a market runs on. When methane emissions can be trusted, they can be priced, penalised and traded, and tens of billions of regulated value ride on getting that number right. Verification is the layer beneath all of it, the reference every certificate, penalty and trade points back to. That is the position Quantum Envelope is building toward, the way ratings agencies and exchanges sit beneath financial markets.

We keep the standard open and independent of the company, because a verification standard owned by the company that profits from it is worth nothing to the people who rely on it. Independence makes the figure trusted. Trust is the product.

Name: Impacta.io
Description:
Climate capital varies in efficiency by 2.4 million-fold. The difference between the most and least efficient climate investments isn't marginal — it's six orders of magnitude. Yet no standard metric tells investors which companies deliver the most carbon avoidance per euro invested.

Impacta.io developed the Climate Efficiency Ratio (CER) — a metric that quantifies tonnes of CO2e avoided per euro of market capitalisation. Across 100+ public companies and 24 sectors, CER reveals that allocation decisions within climate investing matter far more than the decision to invest in climate itself.

Our research is available as a preprint on SSRN. Key findings include a 20x interquartile range among typical climate companies, 18x variation within electric vehicles alone, and 119x within solar — demonstrating that even among direct peers, efficiency differs dramatically.

Whom this matters to: Climate-focused PE/VC firms, family offices, impact funds, and financial advisors seeking to understand the carbon efficiency of their capital allocation.

Founded by Jay Pazos — Chicago Booth MBA, ex-McKinsey, 20 years in finance.
